description:
List supported areas

Cities, neighborhoods and states Atly covers — densest in the United States, with pockets in Mexico, Israel and Thailand — each with an `id` you can pass to
search, a center, a bounding box when known, and how many places it holds. Filter with `q` (substring of
the name) and `level` (city, neighborhood, state). Results are ordered by place count.

limit.description: Maximum areas to return, at most 200; a larger value returns 200.

q.description: Area name or common abbreviation, e.g. "san diego", "midtown", "nyc". Exact and prefix matches rank first.

name: list_areas

country.description: Country the area is in. Coverage is densest in the United States

region.description: State for US cities and neighborhoods; the equivalent district or province elsewhere.

title: Find areas
